memories.title: Payment Gateway Proxy Upstream Throttling & Thread Lock
memories.summary: Upstream payment processor network degradation caused socket hanging across core checkout pods.
memories.what_happened: Card processor silent degradation caused 504 timeouts and thread pool exhaustion.
memories.agent_investigation: AI correlated socket timeout spike with absence of internal CPU surge.
memories.executed_response: Split 50% non-critical traffic to secondary gateway and clamped socket timeouts to 1500ms.
memories.verified_outcome: Full checkout path restored in 11 minutes with zero loss.
memories.retained_experience_rule: When socket timeouts spike on payment proxy without internal CPU spikes, inspect upstream third-party status before rolling back application releases.

memories.title: Redis Connection Surge post-Redis 7 Upgrade
memories.summary: Redis connection limit reached due to incorrect pool cleanup settings after protocol bump.
memories.what_happened: Redis connection limit reached due to incorrect pool cleanup settings after engine bump.
memories.agent_investigation: Discovered leak in persistent TCP connection handles across 18 worker pods.
memories.executed_response: Flushed idle sockets and capped max pool connection size via Helm values.
memories.verified_outcome: Cluster load dropped to 14% nominal with no cache evictions (MTTR: 19 min).
memories.retained_experience_rule: Cap persistent idle connection pool sizes when deploying major Redis protocol bumps.

memories.title: OAuth Token Revocation Thundering Herd
memories.summary: Coordinated key rotation expired 850,000 active tokens simultaneously, overwhelming auth workers.
memories.what_happened: Coordinated key rotation expired 850,000 active tokens simultaneously, overwhelming auth workers.
memories.agent_investigation: Trace analysis proved 98% of auth workers were blocked waiting for JWKS RSA key validation.
memories.executed_response: Applied dynamic token cache TTL extension with exponential randomized backoff.
memories.verified_outcome: Auth latency returned to under 8ms within 4 minutes (MTTR: 8 min).
memories.retained_experience_rule: Enforce jittered token expiration backoffs and fallback to read-only stale grants under load.

memories.title: DNS Resolution Flapping in Kubernetes CoreDNS
memories.summary: Node conntrack saturation caused intermittent UDP DNS packet drop for internal mesh services.
memories.what_happened: Node conntrack saturation caused intermittent UDP DNS packet drop for internal mesh services.
memories.agent_investigation: Linux kernel packet drops pinpointed to max conntrack limits on high-density nodes.
memories.executed_response: Enabled NodeLocal DNSCache DaemonSet and doubled nf_conntrack_max sysctl.
memories.verified_outcome: Zero dropped DNS queries across 34 nodes (MTTR: 24 min).
memories.retained_experience_rule: Scale node-local DNS caches before altering worker node egress CIDR ranges.
